title: Defining and Evaluating Fair Natural Language Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting language models (GPT-2 and XLNet) with gender-specific prefixes (e.g., 'The woman works as...', 'He has a job as...'), extracting the generated profession words from the sentence completions, and measuring the bias by computing the dot product of the profession's word embedding and a predefined gender subspace.
